CommunityApplications.Profile: Unraid templates for the container images published by cplieger: plex-language-sync (per-show audio and subtitle language sync for Plex), plex-exporter (Plex metrics for Prometheus and Grafana), fclones-scheduler (scheduled duplicate-file cleanup) and seadex-scout (flags anime releases SeaDex rates better than the copy on disk). Every image is open source, built from a small Go binary on a distroless base and published for amd64 and arm64. Support for an app goes to that app's GitHub issues, linked from each template; a problem with a template itself goes to this repository's issues.
